legend: Hamartoma shows breast tissue that is indistinguishable from normal breast parenchyma.
The gross appearance of a breast hamartoma (adenolipoma) shows a well-circumscribed adipose mass. Fig. <<48303>> shows the histology of the same lesion.
On histology, the lesion seen in Fig. <<48302>> shows encapsulation by a thin fibrous layer, and it is composed of predominantly mature adipose tissue within which are benign breast lobules.
Mammography shows a well-circumscribed mass containing fat and calcifications.

legend: The macroscopic appearance of a breast hamartoma shows a well-circumscribed oval fatty nodule with fibrous areas, measuring as much as 40 mm, accompanied by a rim of surrounding breast tissue.

An ultrasound image of a breast hamartoma shows a wider than tall, circumscribed, gently lobulated hypoechoic nodule interspersed with strands of echogenecity, without posterior shadowing. The hypoechoic appearance corresponds to fatty tissue while the hyperechoic foci represent breast fibroglandular stroma.
source: Henry Oscar, radiologist, Luma Medical Centre Singapore

legend: The breast hamartoma shows a circumscribed contour with fibrofatty areas containing scattered lobules.
Higher magnification shows benign breast tissue with mild fibrocystic changes, giving a breast-within-a-breast appearance. The circumscribed border is seen inferiorly.

Hamartoma
The section shows a predominantly circumscribed lesion composed of benign breast tissue with fibrohyalinized stroma admixed with adipose tissue in keeping with a hamartoma. Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia is noted within the hamartoma.

Circumscribed breast mass is composed of adenotic lobules displaying focal lactational changes in the form of vacuolated epithelial cells with a hobnailed appearance. Adipocytes are incorporated within the circumscribed boundary.
The patient stopped breast feeding a year ago.
(H&E)

Circumscribed lesion composed of fibroadenoma-like areas showing mixed pericanalicular and intracanalicular growth patterns merging imperceptibly with expanses of adipose tissue containing benign breast lobules that are reminiscent of a hamartoma.
